provenance: Seven parsed official-source adapter captures plus reviewed MHCLG ODS-derived observations and independently paired EIA/BoE observations. Original ODS/HTML and source-cell/pairing evidence are archived; original raw BoE/ONS HTTP bodies are unavailable except explicitly archived evidence.
limitations: Only reference dates strictly before each indicator's former first stored reference day were added. No existing observations were replaced and no earlier headline or pillar history rows were rewritten.
Frozen current readings are identical across sensitivity scenarios. Any score change is baseline coverage, not a new market move or Budget attribution.
Direct official IUDSIZC is used for five-year implied inflation; old nominal-minus-IUDSIZC derived capture is excluded.
Historical writer guards dates/non-finite/hash only. Passing guards does not independently establish economic meaning; definitions were checked against primary catalogues.
BoE publication timestamps are unavailable. Observed 16:00 is the existing daily series convention, not a verified release time.
ONS updateDate may reflect later source revisions. These are current-vintage historical indicators for baseline distributions, not as-known-at-the-time score history.
COVID Q2 2020 rows remain possible source observations but are excluded from baseline using unchanged policy.

Current global baseline eligibility begins in 2019, but other indicators remain shorter where comparable official history is not yet prepared. The expansion does not make every indicator complete from 2019.

Production application completed after explicit user approval, with audited missing-only writes, normal score recomputation and verified public correction/timeline publication. Original records and earlier published score history were preserved.
